definition: Self-perpetuating means able to keep itself going without outside input.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word self-perpetuating. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know self-perpetuating should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Gossip in a small office is self-perpetuating: every denial becomes a fresh reason to keep talking.
Ongoing is the weakest claim — it says only that a thing has not stopped, not why; a self-perpetuating process supplies the why, generating its own continuation.

Self-sustaining stops just short of self-perpetuating: a self-sustaining camp meets its own needs while conditions hold, but a self-perpetuating system also produces the conditions for its own next round.

Self-renewing points at upkeep: the thing replaces its own parts as they wear, the way a forest replaces its trees. Self-perpetuating claims continuation itself — the process produces the conditions for its own next round, whether or not any part gets repaired along the way.

Self-propagating things spread themselves into new copies — a self-propagating plant seeds new plants, a self-propagating rumor breeds new versions. The claim is about multiplication. Self-perpetuating is about one continuing thing: the same board, the same legend, supplying its own next round without outside help.

The fame itself does the work.
